body:
Steps to reproduce:

1.  Use Toggle with CurrentRefinements
2.  Click on Toggle component
3.  Refinement is shown in CurrentRefinements
4.  Remove Refinement from CurrentRefinements
5.  BUG: Toggle was not unchecked.

comments.body:
Hi @klacointe, thank you very much for reporting this! 

I think the appropriate fix would be to rename the prop `checked` to `currentRefinement` inside the `connectToggle` connector. That way we stay consistent with all the other connectors. 

I can make the fix if you want, or you can modify your PR. Tell me what works best for you :)

Hi @mthuret, thanks for you reply.

I've updated the PR.

title: Fix Toggle component used with CurrentRefinements
